data.name: Anca
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Roman word 'anca' meaning 'graceful, pleasant'. In Christian tradition, Anca is a feminine name signifying charm and elegance.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the spiritual grace and beauty bestowed upon us by God.

in_hebrew.name: אנקא
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אנקא הוא שם שמשמעותו חסד אלוהים, חסד ה' לנצח. השם מופיע בשורשיו בכתבי הקודש כחלק מהבטחות ה' לעמו, המעידות על מחויבותו הנצחית לאהבה וחסדו. השם מושאל מלשון יוון ומקושר לנצרות במסגרת השמות הנוצריים הנקשרים לשורשים מקראיים.

in_greek.name: Άνκα
in_greek.long_meaning: Η Άνκα είναι όνομα που σημαίνει Χάρις Θεοῦ, Ἀγάπη Ἀιώνιος. Το όνομα έχει τις ρίζες του στην ελληνική γλώσσα και συνδέεται με τη χριστιανική παράδοση ως ένδειξη της αιώνιας αγάπης και χάριτος του Θεού. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, παρόμοια ονόματα αντανακλούν την πνευματική σχέση του ανθρώπου με το Θείο.

in_latin.name: Anca
in_latin.long_meaning: Anca nomen est quod significat Divina Gratia, Aeterna Caritas. Nomen hoc in traditione christiana invenitur et reflectit relationem spiritualem hominis cum Deo. In Ecclesia primitiva, nomina similia usitata erant ad exprimendam devotionem et gratiam divinam.

in_english.name: Anca
in_english.long_meaning: The name Anca is of Romanian origin, derived from the Greek name 'Anna' or 'Hanna', meaning 'gracious', 'merciful', or 'lovable'. This name has been adopted in various Christian cultures, symbolizing the grace and mercy of God. Anca reflects the spiritual values of kindness, compassion, and devotion, making it a popular choice among Christian parents seeking a name with biblical roots and universal appeal.

data.cultural_impact: Anca, as a Roman name, brings a rich cultural heritage to those who bear it. Its elegant and graceful meaning resonates with those who value beauty and refinement. It is a name that connotes poise, good manners, and an appreciation for art, literature, and the finer things in life. In various cultures, Anca has been associated with artistic expression, as the name has been given to many talented artists, musicians, and writers.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christian tradition, Anca carries a deeper spiritual meaning. It reminds us of God's grace and the beauty of His creation. The name Anca can be seen as a reminder to live our lives in a way that reflects the elegance and charm of God's love. It can also be seen as a call to be graceful and pleasant in our interactions with others, spreading kindness and beauty in the world around us. Ultimately, the name Anca encourages us to appreciate the elegance and grace in all aspects of life, and to strive to live in a way that exemplifies these qualities.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Anca was a princess of Dacia, a region in the Roman Empire. The name Anca carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Dacia was a province of the Roman Empire from 106 AD to 275 AD.
